claims.claim_text: The United States Army is Alfred Reifman's best-supported immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
claims.evidence_excerpt: U. S. Army, 1942 to 1944; July 1944 to Sept. 1945, Economic Analyst, Office of Strategic Services
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official chronology places Army service directly before OSS economic-analysis work beginning in July 1944.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identification based on the distinctive exact name and official Army-to-OSS chronology.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded: Army service is listed for 1942-1944 and OSS service begins in July 1944; no intervening affiliation is reported.
claims.match_notes: The source does not name a specific Army unit or explicitly say transferred, so the record is not labeled explicit_immediate.

claims.claim_text: The United States Office of Price Administration is Alfred Reifman's last documented civilian employer before Army service and OSS work.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official chronology identifies OPA employment, followed by Army service and then OSS work.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identification based on the distinctive exact name and official Army-to-OSS chronology.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded: OPA employment ended in October 1942 and is the final civilian role listed before Army service.
